name: The Odyssey: Defy the Gods
desc:
Defy fate. Sail home.

The official companion to Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey. A survival sailing adventure across the ancient ocean. Pack a crew, ration your supplies, and appease the gods for the right of safe passage.

HOW TO PLAY:
🪵 Scavenge mysterious islands for food, wood, and lost crew
🌊Survive crushing storms and whirlpools
🏛️Solve puzzles on mythic islands for legendary rewards
⚓Sail with friends
🗺️A new sea every voyage

 ⚠️Ages 18+
